text:
Maria K: Nightly eval alert: new quantized model q4_0 has 7 intermittent failures on the 'customer-support' prompt set, started ~02:00 UTC. Samples show repeated prefix bleed and truncated repeats across different sessions. :confused:
Maria K: Example (prompt + two runs):
```
PROMPT: "Customer: I can't access my billing history"
RUN A: "Sure, can you provide your account...
Sure, can you provide your account..."
RUN B: "Here's how to check billing..."
```
Maria K: Runs are nondeterministic and sometimes the reply repeats an earlier prefix from a different conversation id.
Ajay: :eyes: that smells like prefix cache aliasing or KV slot reuse between sessions. Any batching changes in last deploy?
Devon: We shipped a batching optimization yesterday that compresses prefix keys for memory. Could be a hash collision. Which commit?
Maria K: Commit `a3f4c2b` (runtime/batching) + quant artifacts from `q4_0-2026-03-18`
Linh: I ran a quick sweep: failures spike when `max_batch_size >= 16` and when requests include identical 6-token prefixes (e.g., "I can't access"). Pattern looks like key collision on short prefix fingerprints.
Eva: I reran with prefix caching turned off (runtime flag `--prefix-cache=false`) for 5k evals: failure rate dropped from 3.4% -> 0.1%.
Devon: Good repro signal. Can you paste the minimal repro script?
Maria K: Here's a short repro that toggles tenant/session ids:
```bash
# repro.sh - run 2 sessions that share short common prefix
for i in 1 2; do
  curl -s -X POST $API -d '{"session_id":"s'$i'","prompt":"I can\'t access my billing"}' &
done
wait
```
Maria K: Running that with `--batch-window=20ms` reproduces the interleaved prefix ~30% of attempts in my laptop test.
Ajay: Sounds like the prefix fingerprinting (64-bit) isn't salted per-tenant. Quick mitigation: add tenant_id to fingerprint input. That should avoid cross-tenant aliasing.
Devon: I can push a hotfix to runtime: include `tenant_id` + `session_boundary` when computing `prefix_key`. PR: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/2345 (draft). Patch changes at `runtime/cache/prefix_key.cpp` - adds `xxhash(tenant||session||tokens)`
Linh: I tested the patch locally on a small cluster (canary): 10k queries, `max_batch_size=32`, failure rate -> 0.15%. Much better.
Eva: Note: q4_0 still slightly more sensitive due to quant noise; add a short cooldown to reuse cached KV only after full session handshake to be safe.
sre-bot: Canary deployment queued to `dedicated-us-west` pool for PR 2345. ETA ~15m.
Devon: Follow-up: we should add unit test in nightly-evals that injects colliding short-prefixes across sessions and fails the rollout on >0.5% regression. I'll add tests in `evals/robustness/prefix_alias_test.py`
Maria K: Thanks — plan summary: 1) revert unsafe prefix compression if needed, 2) hotfix: add tenant/session salt to prefix_key (Devon), 3) add test (Devon), 4) monitor nightly for 48h (Maria).
Ajay: Assigning owner: @Devon for PR and tests, @Maria for monitoring. :thumbsup:
Maria K: I'll post nightly metrics in #eng-ml tomorrow morning. Good catch everyone.
